turns.content: Let T=67. In rectangle FAKE, EF=T and AF=4T/3. Use triangle AFK to find the diagonal FK and the area of triangle AFK symbolically in T.
Use the triangle area and base FK to determine the altitude from A to FK.

Rectangle FUNK lies in the same plane, shares side FK, and has width UF=12/5 perpendicular to FK. Describe the part of FUNK that lies inside FAKE and why the overlap is clipped near the endpoints of FK.
Use similarity in the two triangular halves adjacent to FK to calculate the combined area of the portions of FUNK outside FAKE.
Subtract those exterior pieces from area(FUNK) to obtain a formula for the intersection area in terms of T.
Check that UF=12/5 lies in the clipped-overlap regime rather than the full-triangle regime, and verify the dimensions of the area formula.
Evaluate the intersection area for T=67.
